nodes.label: Visual General Intelligence: A White Paper
nodes.author: Hirokatsu Kataoka et al.
nodes.rationale: Comprehensive white paper synthesizing diverse perspectives on visual general intelligence as a pathway to AGI, covering video models, creativity, embodiment, and physical understanding.

nodes.label: Visual General Intelligence (VGI)
nodes.rationale: Central concept: intelligence emerging from visual experience through prediction, generation, and reconstruction, potentially independent of language.

nodes.label: Generative Video Models as Visual Foundation Models
nodes.author: Robert Geirhos
nodes.rationale: Hypothesis that large-scale generative video models trained on web data can acquire general-purpose visual capabilities through harder training objectives than recognition.

nodes.label: Creativity as Test of Visual General Intelligence
nodes.author: Aditi Raghunathan
nodes.rationale: Framework for measuring visual intelligence through coherence, structural diversity, originality, and utility of generated outputs in open-ended tasks.

nodes.label: Continual Learning from Visual Experience
nodes.author: Yuki M. Asano
nodes.rationale: VGI should develop throughout visual lifetime without labels or retraining, maintaining coherent world understanding as environment changes.

nodes.label: Multimodal, Generative, and Efficient Intelligence
nodes.author: Deva Ramanan et al.
nodes.rationale: Visual intelligence requires integration of multiple sensory modalities, generative learning, and computational efficiency for practical deployment.

nodes.label: Spatial AI and Persistent World Representations
nodes.author: Andrew J. Davison
nodes.rationale: Spatial AI requires persistent, adaptable representations integrating state estimation, learning, and real-time computation with efficient hardware mapping.

nodes.label: Embodied Visual Intelligence
nodes.author: Yilun Du
nodes.rationale: Visual intelligence through embodied agents: perception guides action, action provides evidence for improving visual understanding in closed loop.

nodes.label: Recovery of Compositional Physical Structure
nodes.author: Shangzhe Wu & Jiajun Wu
nodes.rationale: Visual intelligence should recover entities, intrinsics, extrinsics, relations, and dynamics to support editing, simulation, verification, and action.

nodes.label: Vision-Native Intelligence
nodes.author: Zhuang Liu
nodes.rationale: VGI should be vision-native, learning when to look, where to look, and how much detail is needed, rather than passive processing of predetermined input.

nodes.label: Visual Intelligence for Scientific Discovery
nodes.author: David Fouhey
nodes.rationale: Visual intelligence for science requires handling limited data, validation without ground truth, multimodal integration, systematics/units, and complex reality modeling.

nodes.label: Generative World Models for Embodied AI
nodes.author: Yilun Du
nodes.rationale: Generative world models enable robust perception through inference over latent scene states, supporting prediction, action, and active learning.

hyperedges.label: Complementary Perspectives on Visual General Intelligence
